messages:
anya: Quick monthly synthesis — I pulled together recurring failure signatures across postmortems (PM-4821, PM-4892, PM-4938). TL;DR: 4 actionable patterns, proposed owners, and tentative timelines. Please ACK and flag conflicts by EOD.

sam: Thanks Anya — can you paste the short signatures here?

anya: Sure — concise list: 
1) KV cache evictions on quantized LLMs -> transient latency spikes + incorrect fallback selection
2) Autoscaler thrash during traffic bursts -> delayed pod provisioning
3) Batching-induced OOMs on long-context requests -> node crashes
4) Rollout mismatches (model variant + tokenizer) -> silent quality regressions

maria: For (1) do we have a repro trace and affected customers?

anya: Yes — repro attached to PM-4821. Affected customers: 3 mid-market, high-LLM throughput. Root cause: cache TTL + quantized KV miss rate. Short grep of the tail logs: 
```
2026-07-12T14:03:02Z WARN kv_cache: miss(seq=1024) model=q8_7b
2026-07-12T14:03:02Z INFO fallback: selected=model-1.3b
2026-07-12T14:03:03Z WARN latency: p95=620ms
```

kevin: Proposal for (1): increase prefix cache retention for q8_7b and add metric alert on kv_miss_rate > 0.02. Owner: @kevin. ETA: beta fix by 2026-07-22, canary 2026-07-24.

diane: For (2) autoscaler thrash — I can own. Root cause looks like aggressive downscale config + slow GPU boot. Plan: adjust cooldowns, add soft capacity buffer, and instrument startup time. Owner: @diane. ETA: config change + metrics by 2026-07-18.

sam: For (3) batching OOMs — is this solved by per-request max_tokens guard?

maria: Partly. We still see corner cases where long-context requests get grouped. Quick mitigation: cap group size for requests with sequence_length > 4096. Owner: @maria. ETA: config and rollout by 2026-07-19.

anya: For (4) rollout mismatches — we need a preflight tokenization sanity check in the rollout pipeline and a canary that validates sample prompts. Owner: @anya + @kevin (pipeline + model config). ETA: implementation by 2026-07-26.

incident-bot: Action items created: AI-133, AI-134, AI-135, AI-136. Due dates populated.

kevin: I added dashboards for kv_miss_rate and fallback_rate; linking in comments. :thumbsup:

diane: Quick question — do we want post-deploy smoke checks to run on Dedicated vs Hosted differently? I propose stricter checks on Dedicated (SLA customers).

anya: Agreed. Diane — make a short proposal doc and ping infra-owners.

sam: Acked. I'll coordinate with Solutions for customer notifications if the timeline slips.

maria: I'll start the gating PR for batching limits and add unit tests for sequence grouping.

anya: Great. Final ask: everyone drop a short status update in this thread when you have your PRs or dashboards linked. We'll review at next incident sync (2026-07-27). :calendar: :eyes:

kevin: linked PRs and dashboard in comments.

maria: PR opened: refs/pull/678 - batching caps.

diane: Config PR opened: refs/pull/679 - autoscaler cooldowns.

anya: Closing loop — I'll update the postmortem tracker with owners/timelines and mark these as "recurring-patterns" in the action taxonomy. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
